articles.title: Ethena looks beyond crypto to squeeze yield from booming equity perpetuals
articles.snippet: The issuer of the $4 billion USDe token said it expects real-world asset perpetuals to eclipse crypto derivatives in its backing within 12 to 24 months.

articles.title: California Senate passes bill to ban memecoin issuance by public officials
articles.snippet: The bill seeks to prohibit the listing of memecoins issued by federal public officials to California residents, citing conflicts of interest and “pay-to-play arrangements.”

articles.title: ENA token rises 10% as Ethena puts revenue-funded token buybacks to vote
articles.snippet: The Ethena Foundation proposed buying the token supply held by major early investors and revealed a fee switch to turn 95% of net protocol revenue into ENA buybacks.

articles.title: Bernie Sanders Vows Legislation to 'Stop Flock and AI Mass Surveillance'
articles.snippet: The Vermont senator warned that the surveillance company's 120,000-plus AI cameras are pushing the US toward a "surveillance state," adding a prominent voice to a growing bipartisan backlash.

articles.title: Red Flag? OpenAI's Agentic ChatGPT Work Signs Into Your Accounts Without You
articles.snippet: OpenAI says the model never sees your password—but a signed-in session can persist across tasks, and you can step away while it works.
